title: Beaver's Jumping Track (Easy Version)
statement: A track has n platforms; platform i spans d_i cells and charges s_i penalty points whenever a jump starts and lands on it. A beaver jumps forward one to x cells. Updates change one platform's length or penalty; queries ask the minimum penalty to go from the first cell of platform l to the last cell of platform r, with n up to a million and x at most 5.
